nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m, n \ge 2$ with $m \mid n$, we have $\lceil n / (\lceil n/(m-1) \rceil - 1) \rceil = m$.
nodes.title: A nested ceiling identity for divisors

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $r$ a nonzero even natural number, and write $S(m)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$. Let $w_1, w_2, u$ be units of $\mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$ such that the reduction $(w_1 \bmod p, w_2 \bmod p)$ has no $S(p)$-weighted zero-sum subsequence. Then the sequence $(u w_1, u w_2, p w_1, p w_2)$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$ has no $S(p^r)$-weighted zero-sum subsequence.
nodes.title: Four-term sequences without square-weighted zero-sum subsequences

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a positive even natural number whose $2$-adic valuation $v_2(n)$ is odd, and let $S(n)$ be the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n$. Then the $S(n)$-weighted Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}_n$, with weights the representatives in $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ of the elements of $S(n)$, equals $2$. Moreover, some positive length $k$ forces every sequence of length $k$ in $\mathbb{Z}_n$ to have a non-empty…
nodes.title: Square-weighted constants of numbers with odd $2$-adic valuation

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $r \ge 1$, and let $A = U(p^r)^2$ be the set of squares of units of $\mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$; for $y \in \mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$ write $Ay = \{ay : a \in A\}$. For all units $y_1, y_2, y_3$ of $\mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$, every element of $\mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$ is a sum $x_1 + x_2 + x_3$ with $x_1 \in Ay_1$, $x_2 \in Ay_2 \cup \{0\}$ and $x_3 \in Ay_3 \cup \{0\}$.
nodes.title: Three unit-square cosets sum to every residue modulo an odd prime power

nodes.summary: Let $r \ge 1$ and let $U(5^r)^2$ be the set of squares of units of $\mathbb{Z}/5^r\mathbb{Z}$. If a sequence $s_1, \dots, s_k$ in $\mathbb{Z}/5^r\mathbb{Z}$ has at least four terms, at distinct positions, that are units, then there are $a_1, \dots, a_k \in U(5^r)^2$ with $a_1 s_1 + \dots + a_k s_k = 0$.
nodes.title: Four unit terms force a unit-square-weighted zero sum modulo a power of 5

nodes.summary: For every odd natural number $n \ge 2$ that is a perfect square, the consecutive $S(n)$-weighted zero-sum constant satisfies $C_{S(n)} \le 9$, where $S(n)$ is the set of nonzero squares of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Consecutive square-weighted constant of an odd square is at most nine

nodes.summary: Square-weighted consecutive constant of $p^r$ for prime $p \ge 7$ and even $r \ge 4$ is at most five. Let $p \ge 7$ be a prime and $r \ge 4$ an even natural number. Write $S(p^r)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_{p^r} = \mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}$ and $C_{S(p^r)}$ for the $S(p^r)$-weighted consecutive constant of $\mathbb{Z}_{p^r}$. Then $C_{S(p^r)} \le 5$.
nodes.title: Square-weighted consecutive constant of $p^r$ for prime $p \ge 7$ and even $r \ge 4$ is at most five

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be an odd perfect square and let $p \ge 7$ be a prime with $p^4 \mid n$. Write $S(n)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Then some positive length $k$ has the property that every sequence of $k$ elements of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ has a nonempty block of consecutive terms with an $S(n)$-weighted sum equal to zero, and the least such length, the $S(n)$-weighted…
nodes.title: Square-weighted consecutive constant five for odd squares with a large prime fourth power

nodes.summary: Let $r \ge 4$ be an even natural number. Write $S(5^r)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_{5^r} = \mathbb{Z}/5^r\mathbb{Z}$ and $C_{S(5^r)}$ for the $S(5^r)$-weighted consecutive constant of $\mathbb{Z}_{5^r}$. Then $C_{S(5^r)} \le 7$.
nodes.title: Square-weighted consecutive constant of $5^r$ for even $r \ge 4$ is at most seven

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be a perfect square with $5^4 \mid n$. Write $S(n)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and $C_{S(n)}$ for the $S(n)$-weighted consecutive constant of $\mathbb{Z}_n$. Then $C_{S(n)} \le 7$.
nodes.title: Square-weighted consecutive constant of squares divisible by 625 is at most seven

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be an odd squarefree natural number and let $n = m^2$ with $n \ge 2$. Write $S(n)$ for the set of nonzero squares of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Then there is a positive length $k$ such that every sequence $x_1, \dots, x_k$ in $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ has a nonempty block of consecutive terms $x_i, \dots, x_j$ and weights $a_i, \dots, a_j \in S(n)$ with $a_i x_i + \dots + a_j x_j = 0$, and the consecutive…
nodes.title: Consecutive square-weighted constant of the square of an odd squarefree number

nodes.summary: For every odd natural number $r$, the consecutive $S(2^r)$-weighted zero-sum constant satisfies $C_{S(2^r)} \le 2$, where $S(2^r)$ is the set of nonzero squares of $\mathbb{Z}/2^r\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Consecutive square-weighted constant of an odd power of two is at most two

nodes.summary: Let $U(25)^2$ be the set of squares of units of $\mathbb{Z}_{25} = \mathbb{Z}/25\mathbb{Z}$. Some positive length $k$ has the property that every sequence of $k$ elements of $\mathbb{Z}_{25}$ has a nonempty block of consecutive terms with a $U(25)^2$-weighted sum equal to zero, and the least such length, the $U(25)^2$-weighted consecutive constant $C_{U(25)^2}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_{25}$, equals $9$.
nodes.title: Unit-square-weighted consecutive constant modulo 25 equals nine

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $r \ge 0$ and let $e_1, \dots, e_r \ge 1$ be natural numbers. The Davenport constant $D(G) = D_{\{1\}}(G)$ of $G = \mathbb{Z}/p^{e_1}\mathbb{Z} \oplus \dots \oplus \mathbb{Z}/p^{e_r}\mathbb{Z}$ is $D(G) = 1 + \sum_{i=1}^{r} (p^{e_i} - 1)$. For $r = 0$ the group $G$ is trivial and this reads $D(G) = 1$.
nodes.title: Olson's theorem for abelian $p$-groups

nodes.summary: For positive integers $h$ and $k$ with $h \mid k$, the Davenport constant $D(G) = D_{\{1\}}(G)$ of $G = \mathbb{Z}/h\mathbb{Z} \oplus \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ is $D(G) = h + k - 1$.
nodes.title: Olson's theorem for groups of rank at most two

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $r$ be a nonzero even natural number, let $S(p^r)$ be the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_{p^r}$, and let $A$ be the set of integers $a$ with $0 \le a < p^r$ whose residue modulo $p^r$ lies in $S(p^r)$. Then the $A$-weighted Davenport constant $D_{S(p^r)}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_{p^r}$ is at most $5$.
nodes.title: The square-weighted Davenport constant of an even power of an odd prime is at most five

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be an odd perfect square, let $S(n)$ be the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n$, and let $A$ be the set of integers $a$ with $0 \le a < n$ whose residue modulo $n$ lies in $S(n)$. Then the $A$-weighted Davenport constant $D_{S(n)}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ equals $5$.
nodes.title: The square-weighted Davenport constant of an odd square is five

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be an odd perfect square, let $S(n)$ be the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n$, and let $A$ be the set of integers $a$ with $0 \le a < n$ whose residue modulo $n$ lies in $S(n)$. Then the $A$-weighted Davenport constant $D_{S(n)}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ is at least $5$.
nodes.title: The square-weighted Davenport constant of an odd square is at least five

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ and $a$ be natural numbers, and let $A = \{(a + i) \bmod n : 0 \le i < \lceil n/2 \rceil\}$ be the set of remainders modulo $n$ of the $\lceil n/2 \rceil$ consecutive integers $a, a + 1, \dots, a + \lceil n/2 \rceil - 1$. If $0 \notin A$, then the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ is $D_A(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}) = 2$.
nodes.title: Xia's theorem on arithmetic progressions of weights

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a positive integer, $p$ a prime dividing $n$ and $k = v_p(n)$ the exponent of $p$ in $n$. For the weight set $A = \{a \in \{1, \dots, n - 1\} : p \nmid a\}$, the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ is $D_A(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}) = k + 1$.
nodes.title: Weighted Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ for the weights prime to $p$
